title: Mongo Santamaria and percussionist leaders
summary: He says Mongo was unoriginal and conga players lack background.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Okay. What about, now, a man who did a lot of mixing in the '60s, musical mixing, was Mongo Santamaria. Mongo's band here in the '60s.

Let me tell you one thing. I cannot find no original that Mongo ever did. I don't think -- his mind don't move that way. I don't think he got the capacity. I hate to say this, but let's put everything in a respectable place. That's my own opinion.
I got a right to my own opinion. And I can always challenge my opinion.
Or now anybody can challenge my own opinion. I'm talking musical. I'm a musician and I'm supposed to talk like a musician. Mongo Santamaria started a group that was a terrific group.
When he had a ________, a flute player, Quincy Jones, and I think they had the -- but he had a bunch of good jazz men.
Yeah. One time he had Hubert Lawes.

And he came along and one time got lucky and got hold of that (unintelligible). Then one by one the people started leaving. He started replacing with Latins. And that was the end of that. That was the end of him. Yeah, he's still living, but that was the end of him.
Why? Because there's nothing in the back of his mind. He cannot produce nothing. What can he produce? He's limited. He didn't create nothing.
Do you feel that congo players don't make good bandleaders?
Well, maybe so, I don't know. I don't know none that have up to now.
I've heard it said that the problem with percussionist bandleaders is that they don't have the musical background and the writing skills.

Well, you got to be able to one thing or the other one. I mean, let's face it. Some people might come along that be a conga player but with a knowledge of something else in the back of his mind, ideas or something. But (unintelligible) idea to move his own music, how can he move jazz when he never was related to that. Same thing happened with (unintelligible) didn't want to play Latin no more because he was going to the American side. And what
happened with it? What has he done up to today? Now he throw his hat in the ring the other day and said he's going to have to get another (unintelligible). Why? Because he flopped all over himself.

He (unintelligible) and Mongo. That's all he heard. And then he thought he was a king. And a couple of Latin magazines spoke about how big he is, and they found out (unintelligible) with nothing to fill in with it, so he didn't know where to go. Then he had to go by himself, like a blind man when you take a dog away from him. He can't work no more because he used to work with the dog. The dog used to lead him. Same thing happened to some of these guys.
Let's face it, that's exactly what it is. Anybody can analyze it down, and listen to the music. And I like the music, I know exactly what happened.
